convenciones.watts: positive = generates power, negative = consumes power
convenciones.capacidad_wh: batteries only (energy storage in watt-hours); 0 for everything else
convenciones.slots: fairing slots: how much space the part takes inside the rocket's payload fairing
convenciones.calor: heat the part gives off, scale 0-10 (low=2, medium=4, high=7, extreme=10; 0 = none)
convenciones.requiere: ALL ids in the list must be on the ship
convenciones.requiere_alguno_de: at least ONE id in the list must be on the ship
convenciones.incompatible: the listed ids cannot be combined with this part
convenciones.sinergia: ids of parts or mission-objective tags (e.g. mapeo_orbital) that give a bonus
convenciones.vulnerable_a: ids of events that damage the part (see eventos_sugeridos)
convenciones.penalizaciones: list of rules. {si_falta: id} or {si_falta_ninguno_de: [ids]}; if the condition is not met, 'efecto' applies
convenciones.ids: lowercase, no accents, underscores. Must match the key. Must be identical across all team files
convenciones.tags: capabilities of the part. A mission can require a tag (any part with it will do) or a specific id
convenciones.alcance_ua_max: optional (antennas): maximum communication distance in astronomical units (AU)
convenciones.solo_mision: optional: 'humana' (crewed) or 'robotica' (robotic). The part only applies to that mission type
convenciones.requiere_aterrizaje: optional: true = only works if the mission includes a landing (aterrizaje=true in missions.json)
convenciones.mitiga: optional: ids of events whose damage the part reduces or cancels
convenciones.ciencia_base: optional (instruments): science points per use turn. Game value
convenciones.aporta_capacidad_masa: engines and boosters only: adds to lift capacity (game units)
convenciones.masa_cuenta_como_carga: if false, its mass does not count as load to lift (default true)
convenciones.isp_vacio_real_s: real specific impulse in vacuum (s); informational only
convenciones.resumen: short one-line text shown in the hover tooltip
convenciones.tipo_combustible: propellant the part burns or stores
convenciones.masa_combustible_incluida: ship tanks only: how many mass units of the part's own 'masa' are propellant (already counted in masa)

meta.regla_distancia_solar: real_power = watts * (1 / distance_in_AU^2). Mars (~1.5 AU) gets about 43% of Earth's sunlight, Jupiter (~5.2 AU) about 4%. Only applies to parts with depende_del_sol = true.
supuestos: Heat level and TRL of the star tracker were not in the original table: assumed 2 and 9.

Hydrazine Isp set to 220 s (game value): NASA's electrothermal hydrazine thruster spec asks for over 200 s steady-state; delivered values reported are about 230 s (NRC) and 223-229 s (Aerojet MR-107V).
The ship's hydrazine (2 of the tank's 3 mass units) is already inside the tank's mass. It gives roughly 100-430 m/s of ship delta-v for corrections and wheel unloading, never the main transfer burn.

rueda_reaccion.descripcion: A spinning electric rotor. When it speeds up or slows down, the spacecraft turns the opposite way, because angular momentum is conserved. It lets a ship rotate in a vacuum without burning any fuel.
rueda_reaccion.precio_real_ref: From about 4,100 EUR (CubeSat, NanoAvionics); about 4,800 USD estimated (Georgia Tech student project). Wheels for large spacecraft cost far more
rueda_reaccion.efecto_juego: Points the ship without using fuel, but wheels eventually saturate (reach their top speed) and need thrusters to shed the accumulated spin.
rueda_reaccion.notas: Real wheels store between 0.04 and 45 Nms of angular momentum (NASA S3VI).

propulsor_rcs.descripcion: Small rocket engines that fire a puff of monopropellant (a single liquid fuel that decomposes over a catalyst) to push or turn the spacecraft.
propulsor_rcs.resumen: Small jets to turn and fix the orbit.
propulsor_rcs.precio_real_ref: About 50,000 USD (Georgia Tech student CubeSat project; not NASA data)
propulsor_rcs.efecto_juego: Lets the ship correct its orbit, for example after a geomagnetic storm, and unload the reaction wheels.

tanque_monopropelente.descripcion: A tank of hydrazine, the fuel for the RCS thrusters.
tanque_monopropelente.efecto_juego: If the Temperature drops to Freezing, the hydrazine freezes and the thrusters fail.
tanque_monopropelente.notas: NASA documents a hydrazine freezing risk at roughly 0.1-1.6 C; it is reduced with heaters and insulation: nasa.gov/general/risk-of-hydrazine-use-following-freeze-thaw-exposure Of its 3 mass units, 2 are hydrazine.
tanque_monopropelente.combustible_real_ref: Hydrazine monopropellant: about 220-230 s delivered (NASA NTRS 19720014170 spec: over 200 s; NRC: about 230 s). Real small tanks hold about 80 kg (ArianeGroup PM25, not NASA)

sensor_estrellas.descripcion: A small camera that recognizes star patterns and compares them with a built-in catalog to work out exactly where the spacecraft is pointing.
sensor_estrellas.resumen: Finds where it points by reading the stars.
sensor_estrellas.efecto_juego: Greatly increases the scientific accuracy of the cameras and lets the high-gain antenna aim precisely.
sensor_estrellas.notas: Heat level and TRL were not in the original table; assumed (heat 2, TRL 9).
